name: mirage
text:
Two kinds of bets: GitHub's engine places the automatic ones (the engine's auto-bet and bids). Bets you tap yourself, in the list or in CNO, have always gone from your phone to Novig. Nothing I shipped this week moved them. So the slow ones are your taps, and they were always on the phone.
What slowed them down, honestly: I don't know yet. I know where the time goes. The order leaves in under 0.1 s and the rest, about 5.7 s, is waiting for the order to end. Candidates, in order of likelihood: (1) Novig now takes seconds to match or end an order, so the offer is gone before it's processed. (2) Our reads of the order are being slowed by Novig's rate limit (your report shows 429s). (3) The order stays open until a timer ends it. v1.0.78 records which of these it is for every order. If you try 3 or 4 bets on it, the report that follows will say. If it's (1), no setting of ours fixes it, and I'll make the app work with it, for example by pricing orders so a small move still fills.
